title: Suzanne's mother moves the family to Aztec after reading Scully
place_text: Flora Vista, near Aztec, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Suzanne was born in South Dakota to a mother who was obsessed [music] with UFOs, an obsession sparked by the first book on Aztec, Behind the Flying Saucers, by variety columnist Frank [music] Scully. Suzanne's mother was so inspired by Scully that she moved the entire [music] family to Flora Vista, a suburb of Aztec.

plain: A woman named Suzanne grew up near Aztec, New Mexico, because her mother was obsessed with UFOs and moved the whole family there from South Dakota after reading Behind the Flying Saucers. That was the first book about a flying saucer said to have crashed at Aztec, and it was written by Frank Scully, a columnist for the show-business paper Variety. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as background to Suzanne's story and as a sign of how far the Aztec tale reached: the family settled in Flora Vista, a suburb of Aztec.
